title: Charming Studio Apartment in Dolores Heights
body:
Welcome to 3321 21st Street, a delightful studio apartment nestled in the highly desirable Dolores Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. This cozy and sunlit unit offers the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and location. Situated just steps from the vibrant Valencia Corridor, you’ll enjoy easy access to some of the city’s best restaurants, cafes, boutiques, and public transportation.

Inside, the unit features a full kitchen with tile flooring and large windows that allow natural light to pour in, making the space feel open and inviting. The main living area boasts beautiful hardwood floors, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere ideal for relaxing or working from home.

Residents will appreciate the unbeatable convenience of this location. With Dolores Park, BART stations, Muni lines, and tech shuttle stops all within close proximity, commuting and exploring the city is a breeze. This is urban San Francisco living at its best.

For added convenience, laundry facilities are available on site. Secure garage parking is also available for an additional monthly fee of $400. Please note that pets are not permitted.

Application Requirements:
Applicants must have verifiable monthly income of at least 1.5 times the rent, a history of good credit and rental references, and no prior evictions. A government-issued photo ID, completed rental application, and $50 application fee are required to apply. Security deposit is equal to one month’s rent. 12 month lease.

For more information or to schedule a viewing, please contact Jessica at show contact info .
Ambati Properties | DRE #01973216

title: 1BR + Office Space with Private Garage – Noe Valley
body:
Located in a 1920s residential building in the Noe Valley area, this unit offers a flexible floor plan with one bedroom, one bathroom, a separate office space, and a private garage.

The layout includes an entry foyer, living room, kitchen, and dedicated dining area. Bay windows bring natural light into the main living spaces and offer views of the surrounding neighborhood and city skyline.

The bedroom includes a walk-in closet, while the additional room can be used as a home office, guest room, study, or extra storage space. Multiple closets throughout the unit provide additional storage options.

The bathroom features marble finishes, and hardwood flooring extends through the main living areas.

A private garage is included and can be used for parking or additional storage. Shared laundry facilities and radiator heat are available within the building.

Conveniently located near public transportation, parks, grocery stores, neighborhood shops, and local services throughout the Noe Valley and Dolores Park areas.

Kindly email alongside with your phone number for easy communication while sending your first message of interest in this property.

title: Located in near the Dogpatch & in the Potrero Hill area
body: Located in near the Dogpatch & in the Potrero Hill area, but backed up to the Mission, the neighborhood offers a bright & relaxed urban atmosphere shaped by thoughtful design, creative energy, & classic San Francisco character. Sun-filled streets, a calm residential feel, and a sense of modern refinement create an inviting setting that feels both inspiring and comfortable to call home. Ideal for full-time city living or the perfect Pied-à-Terre in a prime Potrero Hill location Light-filled 1 bedroom, 1 bath condominium located on the 3rd floor with a desirable southern exposure that fills the home with natural light throughout the day. The unit features an open floor plan, creating a comfortable and functional living space with a seamless flow between living, dining, & kitchen areas. The contemporary feeling kitchen is perfect for home meals and entertaining guests. Conveniently situated near the elevator and including one secure parking space. The well-maintained community offers a wide range of amenities designed for everyday comfort & enjoyment, including a pool and spa, clubhouse, fitness center, guest parking, and beautifully landscaped common areas. A thoughtfully designed residence within a full-amenity complex, offering both convenience and a welcoming place to call home.
